backgroundImage.caption: The 1876-77 squad which played the first Test against Australia
backgroundImage.longCaption: The 1876-77 squad which played the first Test against Australia at Melbourne in March 1877 pictured shortly before they left England.  Back: Harry Jupp, Tom Emmett, Alfred Hogben (a sponsor of the trip), Allan Hill, Tom Armitage. Front: Ted Pooley, James Southerton, James Lillywhite jnr, Alfred Shaw, George Ulyett, Andrew Greenwood. On ground: Harry Charlwood, John Selby.

items.html:
Andrew Greenwood was a diminutive and gutsy batsman who played in the first two Tests. He was also an outstanding fielder in the deep. He represented Yorkshire from 1869 to 1880.
Martin Williamson
